from qiskit_aer import Aer
from qiskit_algorithms import VQE, NumPyMinimumEigensolver
from qiskit_algorithms.optimizers import COBYLA
from qiskit.circuit.library import TwoLocal
from qiskit_nature.second_q.drivers import PySCFDriver
from qiskit_nature.second_q.transformers import ActiveSpaceTransformer
from qiskit_nature.second_q.mappers import ParityMapper
from qiskit_nature.second_q.problems import ElectronicStructureProblem
from qiskit_nature.second_q.transformers import FreezeCoreTransformer
from qiskit_nature.second_q import mappers, solvers
import numpy as np

def vqe_lih_sto3g_frozen_core():
    # Define the driver
    driver = PySCFDriver(
        atom="Li 0 0 0; H 0 0 1.5957",
        basis="sto3g",
        charge=0,
        spin=0,
    )

    # Define the problem
    problem = ElectronicStructureProblem(driver)

    # Apply transformers
    freeze_core_transformer = FreezeCoreTransformer(core_selection_scheme="manual", freeze_core=[0, 1])
    active_space_transformer = ActiveSpaceTransformer(num_electrons=4, num_molecular_orbitals=2)
    problem = freeze_core_transformer.transform(problem)
    problem = active_space_transformer.transform(problem)

    # Mapper
    mapper = ParityMapper()
    second_q_ops = problem.second_q_ops()
    fermionic_hamiltonian = second_q_ops[0]
    qubit_op = mapper.map(fermionic_hamiltonian)

    # Define the solver
    classical_solver = NumPyMinimumEigensolver()
    classical_result = classical_solver.compute_minimum_eigenvalue(qubit_op)
    reference_energy = classical_result.eigenvalue.real

    # Define VQE
    optimizer = COBYLA(maxiter=500)
    ansatz = TwoLocal(rotation_blocks="ry", entanglement_blocks="cz", reps=3, entanglement="full")
    vqe = VQE(ansatz=ansatz, optimizer=optimizer, quantum_instance=Aer.get_backend("statevector_simulator"))

    # Run VQE
    quantum_result = vqe.compute_minimum_eigenvalue(qubit_op)
    ground_state_energy_estimate = quantum_result.eigenvalue.real

    # Calculate the energy error
    energy_error_against_reference = abs(ground_state_energy_estimate - reference_energy)

    # Check chemical accuracy
    chemical_accuracy_achievement = energy_error_against_reference < 1e-3

    # Measurement cost
    measurement_cost = vqe.ansatz.num_qubits

    # Qubit count
    qubit_count = vqe.ansatz.num_qubits

    # Circuit depth
    circuit_depth = vqe.ansatz.depth()

    # Gate count
    gate_count = vqe.ansatz.count_ops()

    return {
        "ground_state_energy_estimate": ground_state_energy_estimate,
        "energy_error_against_reference": energy_error_against_reference,
        "chemical_accuracy_achievement": chemical_accuracy_achievement,
        "measurement_cost": measurement_cost,
        "qubit_count": qubit_count,
        "circuit_depth": circuit_depth,
        "gate_count": gate_count
    }
